_comment: The RunPod resources this service runs on. Ids are this account's, not portable, and are
recorded so a person can find them rather than so a script can recreate them -- creating
an endpoint spends money, which is a decision and not a build step.
The data center is not a preference. A network volume exists in one data center and an
endpoint that binds one is pinned there, so the weight cache decides the region.

endpoints.name: see-through-python
endpoints._note: workersMin 0 so an idle endpoint bills nothing; a job pays for its own worker.

interactor-see-through-cpp: Its image builds iceoryx2's C ABI from source and rustc segfaults under qemu-user, so
it cannot be cross-built from an arm64 machine: qemu: uncaught target signal 11.
It needs a native amd64 builder, which is what .github/workflows/image.yml is for.
